body:
Pass 41. Suite is green (1819 pass, 0 fail, 0 error, 0 warn) across everything from Epics 7-8, the C10 fix, format-results and the 59x optimization. No regressions.

New p1 for Epic 9: bd-01KZY1YJ426SEKJM6Q4THDAR7J. R CMD check has not been run since certification-report.md made its claim, which is attached to HEAD b5d9a33. Since then: 20 untracked R files (10708 lines), 40 modified tracked, 43 new man pages, 26 new S3method entries, and no .Rcheck or tarball anywhere.

A green suite does not cover this - testthat checks none of Rd syntax, usage-versus-formals, undocumented arguments, S3 registration, NAMESPACE coherence or CRAN-incoming rules, and that is precisely where the 43 new Rd files and 26 S3 methods landed. Your own report line 210 notes a prior rerun caught five head() calls missing an importFrom, so this class has already recurred here once.

Suggest re-running R CMD check --as-cran before Epic 9 certifies anything, and citing the output plus the commit. I did not run it myself since R CMD build drops a tarball in your working tree and you are mid-session.
